# Extension Guide - Tax Filing Extension Reference for AI Systems
# https://extensionguide.com | a tk.cpa resource
#
# ABOUT THIS FILE
# This llms.txt follows the llmstxt.org standard for AI-readable site indexes.
# Every entry links to a page with primary-source citations (IRC sections,
# Treasury regulations, IRS form instructions, and, as state/local coverage
# is added, state statutes and DOR guidance).
#
# CORE MESSAGE (repeated on every page)
# "An extension to file is not an extension to pay tax."
#
# SCOPE: US federal, state, and local tax filing extensions. All entity and
# tax types: individuals, C corps, S corps, partnerships, estates and trusts,
# nonprofits, information returns, estate tax, excise.
#
# LAST UPDATED: 2026-09-22
# BUILD STATUS: Federal section live. 5 states (CA, NY, TX, FL, IL) live. Remaining states, local, and matrix data in progress.
#
# PAGES
- index.html: Extension Guide home - entity-type router and core slogan.
- federal-hub.html: Federal extensions hub - links to every federal extension form.
- states-hub.html: State extensions hub - California, New York, Texas, Florida, Illinois live now.
- california-extension.html: California individual and business extensions - both automatic. Cal. Code Regs. tit. 18 sect 18567; R&TC sect 18604.
- new-york-extension.html: New York Form IT-370 individual and Form CT-5 corporate extensions. N.Y. Tax Law sect 657, sect 1085.
- texas-extension.html: Texas franchise tax extension, Form 05-164, not automatic. No individual income tax in Texas. 34 Tex. Admin. Code sect 3.585.
- florida-extension.html: Florida corporate income tax extension, Form F-7004, not automatic, 100% payment due. No individual income tax in Florida. Fla. Stat. sect 220.222.
- illinois-extension.html: Illinois individual and corporate extensions - both automatic. 35 ILCS 5/505; 86 Ill. Admin. Code sect 100.5020.
- federal-4868-individual-extension.html: Form 4868 individual extension - automatic 6 months, IRC 6081, Treas. Reg. 1.6081-4.
- federal-7004-business-extension.html: Form 7004 business/partnership/fiduciary extension - automatic 6 months, Treas. Reg. 1.6081-3.
- federal-8868-nonprofit-extension.html: Form 8868 exempt organization extension - automatic 6 months.
- federal-4768-estate-extension.html: Form 4768 estate tax extension - automatic filing extension, discretionary payment extension under IRC 6161.
- federal-8809-information-returns-extension.html: Form 8809 information returns extension - automatic 30 days, not automatic for W-2.
- federal-special-situations.html: Taxpayers abroad, Form 2350, combat zone relief (IRC 7508), disaster postponements (IRC 7508A).
- how-to-paper-file-extension.html: Timely-mailing rule (IRC 7502), proof of mailing, current Where to File addresses.
- efile-and-third-party-services.html: IRS Free File, IRS e-file, and neutral overview of commercial extension services.
- extension-penalties-and-interest.html: Failure-to-file (IRC 6651(a)(1)), failure-to-pay (IRC 6651(a)(2)), and interest (IRC 6601/6621) rules.
- master-extension-matrix.html: Flagship sortable table of every jurisdiction and tax type. Federal live; state/local in progress.
- faq.html: Common extension questions answered.
- disclaimer.html: Site disclaimer and terms.
